rule.statement: A wrongdoer obtaining the benefit of their own wrong to the detriment of another party has no relevance to this appeal.
rule.supporting_quote: The reliance placed on the ratio of the judgment in Seelawathie Mallawa v Millie Keerthiratne (supra) by the Plaintiff would not render him of any assistance as the principle enunciated in the said pronouncement that a wrong doer obtaining the benefit of his own wrong to the detriment of the other party has no relevance to the instant appeal.
